mapping_json.fidelity_notes: THE reference charge-dump: 'consumes ALL charges at once for a nova scaled per charge consumed — build the stack, dump the stack' (mech_note verbatim). This maps NATIVELY — charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator + accumulator_discharge_threshold (verified engine enum, resource_economy.py:70-74; 'AM spend to fire'). The build-to-cap-then-consume-all rhythm IS the accumulator-discharge primitive. T4 TEMPORAL_CHARGE (charge/stack engine, §5) with MOMENTUM_CASCADE alt. Geometry ring (self-origin nova, §6). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (charge-stack dump engine) + probe (charge meter economy) per fallback. ELEMENT FRICTION: Discharge deals THREE elements simultaneously partitioned by charge type (lightning/fire/cold), each charge-count scaling its own element. Engine element slots hold top-2 (fire endurance + lightning power per §1 hybrids-keep-top-2); the reference ignite-Elementalist build (probe 'burn', mech_note fire) makes fire dominant. Cold (frenzy) dropped, noted. shock->sunder NOT added: the ignite variant is fire-ignite-led, not shock-led; sunder would be a per-charge lightning rider only in the lightning-scaling variant.

verify_ledger.claim_text: [§7 elem_raw anomaly · PROPOSED:AMBIGUOUS-HOLD] elem_raw='fire' — Anchor unambiguously shows Discharge outputs fire+lightning+cold simultaneously. elem_raw='fire' is a PARTIAL characterization (the endurance-charge component, typically the largest stack). No single element is 'correct'; the honest tag is tri-elemental / mixed. Because the current single-element tag is defensible-but-incomplete and 'mixed' would drop it to NULL court (per V-15 magic/mixed→NULL), HOLD and flag for conductor: is a 'mixed(fire/lightning/cold)' re-tag (→ NULL court, cf gd-panettis) warranted?
